audit_metadata.phase: Phase 33 — Multi-Signer Training Strategy and Generalization Audit

signer_01.leakage_risk: HIGH AT FRAME LEVEL: Train and validation splits were generated via random/stratified sampling within the same 5 video sessions. Adjacent frames from the same continuous stream exist in both train and val.

capture_setup.condition_1: Frontal desk camera, neutral upright sitting position, 789 frames across 26 recordings
capture_setup.condition_2: Lateral elevated angle (approx 30 deg offset), resting lap hand visible in lower frame, 832 frames across 26 recordings
capture_setup.signing_style: Deliberate static letter holds with natural breathing tremor

signer_04.leakage_risk: ZERO IN PHASE 22/32 BALANCED SPLIT: Split is partitioned strictly by recording (Letters A-M Cond 1 vs Cond 2; Letters N-Z Cond 2 vs Cond 1; 26 recordings train, 26 recordings val; 0 shared recordings). However, within each letter-condition cell, there is only 1 single continuous recording take.

key_architectural_deficits.impact: Statistical sample size for between-signer variance is N=2. A classifier trained on N=1 or N=2 signers overfits to individual anatomical ratios (finger bone lengths, palm breadth, knuckle spacing) and camera angles.
key_architectural_deficits.evidence: Model C trained on signer_01 drops from ~70% within-signer to 40.16% zero-shot on signer_04, and achieves only 59.22% on sealed signer_05.

key_architectural_deficits.impact: 1,621 frames in signer_04 and 4,211 in signer_01 represent continuous sequential frames from a handful of takes. Adjacent frames differ by milliseconds and share 99% mutual information.
key_architectural_deficits.evidence: Evaluating frame-level random splits creates an illusion of high accuracy that collapses when applied to an unseen signer.

key_architectural_deficits.impact: In signer_04, each letter in each condition was captured in exactly ONE continuous recording (~30 frames). There are zero independent replicates of the same sign by the same signer in the same condition.
key_architectural_deficits.evidence: Cannot evaluate within-signer session-to-session repeatability on signer_04.

key_architectural_deficits.issue: Lack of Demographic and Physical Diversity
key_architectural_deficits.impact: Zero variation in hand anatomy: no elderly hands, no youth hands, no diverse skin tones (Fitzpatrick scale representation is restricted to single tone in s1 and s4).
key_architectural_deficits.evidence: MediaPipe detection confidence and keypoint precision vary systematically across skin pigmentation and hand morphology.
